title: GMS Week 35 - Sanctions Loom, Hulls
summary:
Main
The sanctions package hanging over last week's market has now landed. Washington broadened its economic campaignagainst Iran this week, extending the reach of secondary sanctions and placing shipping firmly within the latest measures. For a recycling market already navigating increasingly complex ownership structures, registries, trading histories and compliance exposure, the implications are clear.
